## Summary of Changes

Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the maintainers why we should accept this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds clinical or UI capability)

## Clinical & Architectural Verification

- [ ] All 45 automated unit/integration tests pass (`npm test`)

- [ ] Tested responsive layouts across mobile (375px) and desktop (1440px)
